name: marimo
description: marimo is a reactive Python notebook: change a cell or move a UI element and every cell that depends on it updates, so code, outputs and state never drift apart. Notebooks are stored as plain Python files that work with git, run as scripts and can be served as interactive web apps, with SQL over dataframes and databases built in.

notes.text: Sign in with the password MARIMO_TOKEN_PASSWORD from /opt/marimo_data/.env. Notebooks are stored in /opt/marimo_data/notebooks.
Everyone who can sign in runs arbitrary Python as root inside the container. Keep the password private and port 2718 on a trusted network.
